ecdev_native.semantics: per captured source, compares typed fields (price_minor exact integer minor units, availability, product data) and reports PRICE_CHANGED / AVAILABILITY_CHANGED / DISAPPEARED (only confirmed 404/410); blocked or UNKNOWN captures preserve the prior baseline; every observed value is also a validity-windowed fact (record_facts)

differences: availability may come from an LLM plugin (get_itemprop_availability_from_plugin, llm.evaluator) - not evidence
text scraped by the browser fetcher ('Possibly in stock') overrides structured availability ('metadata lies') - a guess replacing an assertion
availability is in-stock when it contains any of instock/instoreonly/limitedavailability/onlineonly/presale as a lowercase substring - ECDEV keeps the observed schema.org value
prices compared as Python floats from babel parse_decimal - ECDEV compares exact minor units
a price inside price_change_min/max forces changed_detected=False even when stock changed - ECDEV never suppresses an observed availability change
percent threshold suppression and MD5 of a rendered 'In Stock: ... - Price: ...' snapshot string
multiple prices raise ProcessorException - ECDEV keeps conflicting offers as CONFLICT
layout and copy churn would be reported as change; ECDEV monitors typed product fields

differences: ECDEV has its own MCP/HTTP server, SQLite store, bounded fetchers and persisted watches
